title: Concatenation of restricted runs
statement: Let a WordRAM program run from configuration $c$ to $c_1$ in $n$ steps with every address touched belonging to $K$, and from $c_1$ to $c_2$ in $k$ steps with every address touched belonging to $K'$. Then it runs from $c$ to $c_2$ in $n+k$ steps with every address touched belonging to $K\cup K'$.
hypotheses_covered: A run of $n$ steps from $c$ to $c_1$ whose touched addresses all lie in $K$
A run of $k$ steps from $c_1$ to $c_2$ whose touched addresses all lie in $K'$
